1170-2397-2733-5954-8345.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

7084-8095-8347.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1719-2645-3147-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3147-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

512-1606-1719.easyPrerequisites: Ley Weaver and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1606-1719.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-1606-1719.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Ley Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

512-1902-5475.easyPrerequisites: Wirewood Channeler and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-1902-5475.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
512-1902-5475.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Wirewood Channeler, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1902-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Wirewood Channeler's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1456-1879-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1742-5003-5147-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-5003-5147-7848.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
1742-5003-5147-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

1017-1494-7178-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Topiary Lecturer.

Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 11.

Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ambrosia Whiteheart

Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.

You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Corsair Captain.

Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Gain life.

Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1591-2634-4036-5195.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Seething Song.

Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.

Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.

You control a creature with power 5 or greater.

Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Tolarian Academy.

372-813-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.

Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.

When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Redcap Thief.
When Redcap Thief enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.

Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Redcap Thief that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Redcap Thief token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

Sea Serpent triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

Activate Ethersworn Adjudicator's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.

Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

186-239-2467-4385.description:
All slivers have haste.

Use that mana to create a Sliver with Sliver Queen's ability.
Use the newly created Sliver to repeat the cycle.
